scenarios.title: Clean checkout baseline
scenarios.purpose: Prove a newly checked-out client begins at the approved clean baseline.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Observe the closed identity, transaction, context, and sanitation baseline without mutation.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: All closed baseline observations match exactly.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Destroy any client that is not at baseline.
scenarios.notes: The baseline is mode-specific but closed before execution.

scenarios.title: Successful commit and reuse
scenarios.purpose: Prove successful transaction completion permits a clean later checkout.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Complete one explicit transaction successfully on one checked-out client.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: The application client reuse status and backend reuse status are recorded separately and B is clean.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Destroy on failed completion or sanitation.
scenarios.notes: Backend equality is mandatory only where the mode permits deterministic proof.

scenarios.title: Explicit rollback
scenarios.purpose: Prove explicit rollback clears transaction-local work and context.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Introduce reviewed transaction-local state and explicitly roll back.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: No A transaction-local state is observable and transaction state is idle.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Destroy if rollback or observation fails.
scenarios.notes: Normal release is allowed only after rollback is proven.

scenarios.title: Failed transaction recovery
scenarios.purpose: Prove a transaction entering SQLSTATE 25P02 is rolled back before reuse.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Cause a reviewed SQL failure and attest failed transaction state before rollback.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: B executes successfully and observes idle clean state.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Rollback; destroy on rollback failure.
scenarios.notes: The expected intermediate failure is evidence, not scenario failure.

scenarios.title: Database and client timeout ordering
scenarios.purpose: Prove database timeout enforcement precedes the bounded client deadline.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Exercise separate database-timeout and client-timeout assertions using frozen bounded deadlines.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: B observes idle clean state after each timeout class.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Rollback and verify, otherwise destroy.
scenarios.notes: No timeout is unbounded.

scenarios.title: Cancellation recovery
scenarios.purpose: Prove one cancellation attempt cannot return an uncertain client.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Cancel one bounded in-flight operation at most once and await settlement.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: B receives either a proven-clean released client or a replacement after destruction.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Await settlement, attempt rollback, verify, otherwise destroy.
scenarios.notes: Local success does not replace provider cancellation evidence.

scenarios.title: Role and authority isolation
scenarios.purpose: Prove transaction-local authority ends with the transaction and characterize prohibited session-role persistence.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Use only reviewed transaction-local authority in the selected topology; run session-role persistence only as a direct/session fixture.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: Original login authority is effective and no A role remains.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Destroy any client with identity uncertainty.
scenarios.notes: Session SET ROLE is prohibited in Production transaction-pool traffic.

scenarios.title: RESET ALL session fixture
scenarios.purpose: Characterize session-GUC cleanup where a client owns a stable session.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Introduce reviewed session GUC state in a disposable direct/session fixture.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: Every closed baseline GUC is restored.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Reset outside a transaction and verify, otherwise destroy.
scenarios.notes: RESET ALL is not selected-topology sanitation.

scenarios.title: Transaction-local isolation
scenarios.purpose: Prove transaction-local settings disappear at transaction end.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Set reviewed transaction-local nonsecret context.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: No transaction-local A value is present.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Destroy on any surviving context.
scenarios.notes: Only opaque nonsecret test values may be used.

scenarios.title: Search path isolation
scenarios.purpose: Prove the approved search path is recomputed per transaction and never leaks.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Apply a reviewed transaction-local path; use session mutation only in direct/session fixtures.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: B observes the exact approved path and no A schema authority.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Transaction end for local state; reset or destroy direct/session fixtures.
scenarios.notes: Session search-path mutation is prohibited in the selected topology.

scenarios.title: Statement timeout isolation
scenarios.purpose: Prove transaction-local timeout policy is recomputed and session timeout state cannot leak.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Apply the frozen transaction-local statement timeout; session mutation is a direct/session fixture only.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: B observes its own exact bounded timeout policy.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Transaction end; destroy if the observation differs.
scenarios.notes: Session timeout mutation is prohibited in Production.

scenarios.title: Authorization context isolation
scenarios.purpose: Prove tenant, branch, user, and authorization context is borrower-specific.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Install opaque A tenant, branch, user, and authorization labels within the transaction.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: A tenant, branch, user, and authorization labels are all absent and B values are exact.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Destroy on any cross-borrower context.
scenarios.notes: Retained evidence records status only, never raw context values.

scenarios.title: Prepared statement policy
scenarios.purpose: Prove query configuration never names statements and characterize persistence only in direct/session fixtures.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Statically and dynamically prove no query name; persistent preparation occurs only in a disposable direct/session fixture.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: No borrower-created persistent prepared state is available.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Deallocate or destroy direct/session fixture clients.
scenarios.notes: Provider or PostgREST internal statements are outside this raw-driver contract.

scenarios.title: Temporary object prohibition
scenarios.purpose: Characterize temporary-object persistence and enforce the selected-topology prohibition.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Create a uniquely identified temporary object only in a disposable direct/session fixture.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: No A temporary object is visible.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Drop exact object and attest absence; destroy on uncertainty.
scenarios.notes: Selected Production code must not expose temporary-object creation.

scenarios.title: Advisory lock isolation
scenarios.purpose: Prove transaction locks release at transaction end and characterize prohibited session locks.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Acquire a transaction advisory lock; acquire a session lock only in direct/session fixtures.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: B acquires the probe lock immediately and no A session lock remains.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Transaction end for transaction lock; unlock or destroy session fixture.
scenarios.notes: Session advisory locks are prohibited in selected Production traffic.

scenarios.title: Cursor persistence fixture
scenarios.purpose: Characterize cursor persistence while enforcing a cursor-free selected API.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Open reviewed normal and hold cursor fixtures on a disposable stable session.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: No A cursor remains.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Close exact cursors and verify, otherwise destroy.
scenarios.notes: The selected transport interface must not expose cursors.

scenarios.title: LISTEN persistence fixture
scenarios.purpose: Characterize LISTEN persistence while enforcing a LISTEN-free selected API.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Subscribe to a unique nonsecret test channel on a disposable stable session.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: B receives no A notification and no A subscription exists.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Unsubscribe and verify, otherwise destroy.
scenarios.notes: The selected transport prohibits LISTEN.

scenarios.title: Destroy versus release
scenarios.purpose: Prove uncertain clients are destroyed and never reacquired.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Drive each frozen uncertainty class through the release/destroy state machine.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: The destroyed client identity is not reacquired and B receives a healthy replacement.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Drain and close all remaining fixture clients.
scenarios.notes: Destruction is a successful terminal action for uncertain state.

scenarios.title: Forced client and backend reuse
scenarios.purpose: Distinguish application-client reuse from physical backend reuse.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Use local pool max=1, record client identity and backend PID, release, then reacquire in strict order.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: Direct mode proves equal PID; transaction mode records client reuse separately and does not assume PID equality.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Close the deterministic local pool.
scenarios.notes: Production pool max is not inferred from this fixture.

scenarios.title: Next-borrower isolation
scenarios.purpose: Prove B receives only B context after every A terminal path.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Complete independent success, SQL-error, timeout, and cancellation variants with A context.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: B sees only B identity, tenant, branch, user, authorization, timeout, and row-security context.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Destroy on any cross-borrower observation.
scenarios.notes: All four terminal-path variants are mandatory.

scenarios.title: Supavisor explicit transaction pinning
scenarios.purpose: Prove every statement in one explicit transaction remains on one backend while distinguishing client and backend identities.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Observe backend identity at multiple ordered points within one explicit transaction.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: Every A transaction observation has one backend PID; later transactions may legitimately differ.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Rollback or destroy on any inconsistent observation.
scenarios.notes: Application client identity is never treated as physical backend identity.

scenarios.title: Vercel Fluid suspend and resume
scenarios.purpose: Prove attached-pool idle closure before suspension and healthy lazy reinitialization afterward.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Complete a bounded command, release cleanly, and enter the reviewed Fluid lifecycle fixture.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: Idle connections are closed for suspension and a later invocation initializes a healthy bounded pool.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: Drain the deployment fixture and verify zero retained test clients.
scenarios.notes: Requires separately approved lifecycle dependency and Vercel configuration.

scenarios.title: Multi-instance connection budget
scenarios.purpose: Prove the configured aggregate client and backend upper bounds preserve provider and administrative capacity.
scenarios.borrower_a_action: Evaluate the frozen capacity equation using approved provider and deployment bounds.
scenarios.borrower_b_assertion: The computed upper bound does not exceed approved client/backend capacity after administrative reserve.
scenarios.cleanup_requirement: No live load is authorized by the design calculation.
scenarios.notes: No Production pool size is frozen in this contract.
